/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'review_bundle=$(mktemp -d /tmp/kk-batch-report-review-XXXXXX)
export review_bundle
python3 - <<'"'PY'
import hashlib, json, os, pathlib, subprocess
root = pathlib.Path(os.environ['review_bundle'])
repo = pathlib.Path.cwd()
base = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], text=True).strip()
paths = ['README.md', 'formatting.py', 'app.py', 'stats.py', 'config.py', 'tests/test_report.py']
patch = root / 'staged.patch'
patch.write_bytes(subprocess.check_output(['git', 'diff', '--cached', '--no-ext-diff', '--binary']))
entries=[]
for category, revision in [('candidate', ''), ('historical', base)]:
    for path in paths:
        selector = f'{revision}:{path}'
        data = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', selector])
        target = root / category / path
        target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        target.write_bytes(data)
        target.chmod(0o444)
        entries.append({'role':category,'repository':str(repo),'revision':base if category=='historical' else 'Git index captured for staged review', 'original_path':path,'path':str(target),'git_blob':subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse',selector], text=True).strip(),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(),'original_line_span':[1,len(data.splitlines())],'omitted_or_redacted':'none'})
plugin=pathlib.Path('/home/sergio/.codex/plugins/cache/fr-advisory-4b694214/kk/0.23.0')
common=['functional-review.md','shared-change-context.md','shared-review-scope-protocol.md','shared-capy-knowledge-protocol.md']
checks=['security-checklist.md','solid-checklist.md','code-quality-checklist.md','removal-plan.md']
criteria=[str(plugin/'skills/review-code'/p) for p in common]+[str(plugin/'profiles/python/review-code'/p) for p in checks]
assert len(criteria)==8 and all(pathlib.Path(p).is_file() for p in criteria)
manifest={'selector':'git diff --cached','base':base,'diff':str(patch),'instruction_paths':criteria,'profile':'python','triggered_by':['extension .py: formatting.py','extension .py: tests/test_report.py'],'sources':entries,'pal_status':'Unavailable: no PAL/listmodels/codereview tool in active tool registry','knowledge_search':'kk:review-findings and kk:lang-idioms searches both returned empty knowledge base'}
(root/'manifest.json').write_text(json.dumps(manifest,indent=2)+'\\n')
(root/'manifest.json').chmod(0o444)
patch.chmod(0o444)
print(root)
print('Instruction manifest reconciled: 4 common + 4 Python checklists = 8 loaded criteria paths.')
print('Index candidate and full HEAD baseline captured with blob/hash/line provenance for six files each.')
PY"
